stem: Ojas notes that a pine tree on a cold mountain has a conical shape and sloping branches. Snow slides off the branches in winter.

parts.text: Are the conical shape and sloping branches adaptations for survival on the mountain?

options.text: Yes — they help the pine tree survive heavy snow in that region.
Yes — every feature of every tree is an adaptation for snow.

parts.text: Name one way those features help the pine tree on the mountain.

part_answers.answer: Snow slides off the sloping branches so the branches are less likely to break.

teacher.key_rationale: Special features that help survival in a region are adaptations; conical shape and sloping branches help mountain pines shed snow. Limiting adaptations to animals or treating every feature as a snow adaptation miss the hinge.
